Container.Name: NaviClean
Container.Overview: NaviClean scans and cleans mounted Navidrome music libraries with guided organization previews, duplicate review, unindexed and non-music cleanup, Spotify-backed discovery, and audio conversion.
Container.Description: NaviClean provides a Docker-first web UI for maintaining Navidrome libraries. It stores settings under /data, reads and writes the mounted /music library, defaults to admin/admin authentication, can disable built-in auth for reverse-proxy systems, connects to Navidrome through the Subsonic-compatible API for scans, metadata, and artwork, previews planned organization moves before applying them, stages duplicate and cleanup removals in a recycle bin, can discover missing albums from Spotify metadata with authorized provider downloads, and can convert selected audio files with ffmpeg.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Container 8080 - Host port for the NaviClean web UI

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Stores NaviClean settings, auth configuration, and the latest scan catalog

Config.Name: Navidrome Music Library
Config.Description: Host music folder that Navidrome scans. NaviClean needs read/write access to organize, convert, trash cleanup candidates, and place removed files in /music/.naviclean-trash by default.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid user ID used by NaviClean for /data and /music access. Keep 99 for the default nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Unraid group ID used by NaviClean for /data and /music access. Keep 100 for the default users group.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Express trust-proxy setting. Keep 1 when NaviClean is behind Unraid, Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, authentik, or another reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Cookie secure mode: auto follows HTTPS/proxy headers, true always requires HTTPS, and false allows direct HTTP/LAN testing.

Config.Name: Cookie SameSite
Config.Description: Session cookie SameSite mode. Use lax for normal installs, none for cross-site reverse-proxy flows that require it, or strict for tighter same-site access.

Config.Name: Advanced Diagnostics
Config.Description: Set to 1 to show the internal Diagnostics page and matching-inspection API routes.
